h1: Custom Ice Buckets with Your Brand Artwork
lead: We make custom ice buckets with heat-transfer artwork for bars, bottle service and branded events. Choose an LED or non-LED bucket and send your logo or idea. Our factory team provides free design, a visual mockup, sampling and bulk production.
html:
Questions Before You Order

What are your payment terms?

We require a 30% deposit. The remaining 70% must be paid in full before shipment.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept T/T (bank transfer), Western Union and Alipay.

Which currencies can I pay in?

We accept USD, CNY, EUR and GBP. Other currencies can also be arranged for your order.

Which trade terms do you offer?

We offer EXW (Ex Works), FOB Shenzhen, C&F and DDP. The trade term is agreed with you for each order.

What should I specify when ordering branded ice buckets for a bar?

Send the bucket model, required capacity, quantity, artwork and destination. We offer screen printing and heat transfer decoration, with a free design proposal and a mockup of the selected bucket.

Can one artwork layout be used across different ice bucket sizes?

We adapt the artwork layout to each selected bucket shape and decoration area. Send the model list together so the free mockups show how your brand looks across the range.

Compare the Relevant Products and Service

Email Us for Free Design and a Project Quote
